meta.title: ProjectColourPaletteView

fields.name: colour
fields.mapping: static-config — the stable name/key used throughout the rest of the model

fields.name: hex
fields.mapping: static-config — resolved from 'colour' only when rendering

fields.name: used
fields.mapping: derived:exists(ProjectCreated p where p.colour == this.colour AND not exists(ProjectDeleted d where d.projectId == p.projectId))

meta.description: The lookup table for project colours. 'order', 'colour', and 'hex' are static reference data (not built from any event) — 'colour' is the stable name used everywhere else in the model, 'hex' is only ever resolved here, and 'order' is the fixed cycle position (1–6) that 'Next colour' advances through and wraps at. 'used' is the one derived field: folds ProjectCreated (colour becomes used) and ProjectDeleted (colour becomes free again once its owning project is deleted).
